1140854024754880514.a: I'm going to need a case to carry challenge coins at this rate. I like the metaphor of the first coin issued being made of a fragile material and now NOM has been made full metal. The wooden coin was made in the White House 44 woodshop/makerspace on the laser cutter. #nomcon2019 t.co

1140854777867382785.a: How many challenge coins were actually made inside the White House itself? My guess is these are the only ones. One can admire a shiny gold coin that is well painted. But people scoff "wooden nickel" at the hand made coin made by the actual White House staffers doing real work.

1140855800845492224.a: Backside is hard to photograph. It encodes the analysis of the data we collected in 2018 as a sort of memory of the work we are all doing through time. t.co
